content.json:
## Spark — is it slow, and on what?

Read top to bottom. Section 1 says whether there is a problem; every section after it narrows down where the time goes. Green is fine, orange is over the slow bar, red is roughly "a child gave up waiting".

`Service` is `<slot>.<component>` — `production.spark-backend`, `dev.spark-backend`, `production.spark-web` (the browser), `production.spark-admin`. A service reporting **without** a slot prefix (plain `spark-backend`) is running an image older than the slot-tagging change; it is grouped under the slot **`unlabelled`** so it is still visible here.

parameters.name: Env
parameters.label: Slot
parameters.query:
union isfuzzy=true requests, customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend env = iff(cloud_RoleName has '.', tostring(split(cloud_RoleName, '.')[0]), 'unlabelled')
| where isnotempty(env)
| distinct env
| project value = env, label = env
| union (print value = '*', label = 'All slots')
| order by label asc

content.json: ### 1 · Is there a problem right now

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend env = iff(cloud_RoleName has '.', tostring(split(cloud_RoleName, '.')[0]), 'unlabelled')
| where '*' in ({Env}) or env in ({Env})
| summarize
    Requests = count(),
    ['p50 ms'] = round(percentile(duration, 50)),
    ['p95 ms'] = round(percentile(duration, 95)),
    ['p99 ms'] = round(percentile(duration, 99)),
    ['slow %'] = round(100.0 * countif(duration > {SlowMs}) / count(), 1),
    ['failed %'] = round(100.0 * countif(success == false) / count(), 1)
  by Service = cloud_RoleName
| order by ['p95 ms'] desc
content.title: Server health by service and slot

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend env = iff(cloud_RoleName has '.', tostring(split(cloud_RoleName, '.')[0]), 'unlabelled')
| where '*' in ({Env}) or env in ({Env})
| summarize ['p95 ms'] = round(percentile(duration, 95)) by bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain}), Service = cloud_RoleName
| render timechart
content.title: p95 latency over time — a step up here is a deploy or a cold start

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend env = iff(cloud_RoleName has '.', tostring(split(cloud_RoleName, '.')[0]), 'unlabelled')
| where '*' in ({Env}) or env in ({Env})
| summarize
    Calls = count(),
    ['p50 ms'] = round(percentile(duration, 50)),
    ['p95 ms'] = round(percentile(duration, 95)),
    ['worst ms'] = round(max(duration)),
    Slow = countif(duration > {SlowMs})
  by Endpoint = name, Service = cloud_RoleName
| extend ['slow %'] = round(100.0 * Slow / Calls, 1)
| extend ['time spent (s)'] = round(Calls * ['p50 ms'] / 1000.0)
| project Endpoint, Service, Calls, ['p50 ms'], ['p95 ms'], ['worst ms'], ['slow %'], ['time spent (s)']
| top 30 by ['p95 ms'] desc
content.title: Slowest endpoints — sort by 'time spent' to fix what costs the most in total

content.json:
### 3 · Why — where the time inside a slow request actually went

This joins every request over the slow bar to the outbound calls it made. If `mongo` dominates a row it is a missing index or a chatty query; if it is `HTTP` to APIM it is the model; if it is Kata it is the content API.

content.query:
let slow = requests
  | where timestamp {TimeRange}
  | extend env = iff(cloud_RoleName has '.', tostring(split(cloud_RoleName, '.')[0]), 'unlabelled')
  | where '*' in ({Env}) or env in ({Env})
  | where duration > {SlowMs}
  | project operation_Id, Endpoint = name;
dependencies
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| join kind=inner slow on operation_Id
| summarize
    Calls = count(),
    ['total ms'] = round(sum(duration)),
    ['p95 ms'] = round(percentile(duration, 95)),
    Failures = countif(success == false)
  by Endpoint, Dependency = strcat(type, ' · ', target)
| top 30 by ['total ms'] desc
content.title: Inside the slow requests: which dependency ate the time

content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend env = iff(cloud_RoleName has '.', tostring(split(cloud_RoleName, '.')[0]), 'unlabelled')
| where '*' in ({Env}) or env in ({Env})
| summarize
    Calls = count(),
    ['p50 ms'] = round(percentile(duration, 50)),
    ['p95 ms'] = round(percentile(duration, 95)),
    ['failed %'] = round(100.0 * countif(success == false) / count(), 1)
  by Type = type, Target = target
| top 25 by ['p95 ms'] desc
content.title: All outbound calls — Mongo, APIM/Azure OpenAI, Kata, LRS

content.json:
### 4 · The child's machine — real user experience

The server can be fast and the lesson still slow. `Device` is derived from reported RAM and CPU cores: `low` is the school Chromebook we are actually designing for.

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'spark.vitals.lcp'
| extend env = iff(cloud_RoleName has '.', tostring(split(cloud_RoleName, '.')[0]), 'unlabelled')
| where '*' in ({Env}) or env in ({Env})
| extend Device = tostring(customDimensions['spark.deviceClass']),
         Network = tostring(customDimensions['spark.networkType'])
| summarize
    Sessions = dcount(session_Id),
    ['LCP p50 ms'] = round(percentile(value, 50)),
    ['LCP p75 ms'] = round(percentile(value, 75)),
    ['LCP p95 ms'] = round(percentile(value, 95))
  by Device, Network
| order by ['LCP p75 ms'] desc
content.title: Page load by device class and network — the school-hardware question

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name startswith 'spark.vitals.'
| extend env = iff(cloud_RoleName has '.', tostring(split(cloud_RoleName, '.')[0]), 'unlabelled')
| where '*' in ({Env}) or env in ({Env})
| extend Vital = replace_string(name, 'spark.vitals.', '')
| summarize
    Samples = count(),
    p50 = round(percentile(value, 50), 1),
    p75 = round(percentile(value, 75), 1),
    p95 = round(percentile(value, 95), 1)
  by Vital
| order by Vital asc
content.title: Web vitals — lcp/fcp/ttfb/inp in ms, cls unitless, transferKB in KB, longTaskMs is main-thread blocking

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'spark.api.duration'
| extend env = iff(cloud_RoleName has '.', tostring(split(cloud_RoleName, '.')[0]), 'unlabelled')
| where '*' in ({Env}) or env in ({Env})
| extend Endpoint = tostring(customDimensions['spark.endpoint']),
         Ok = tostring(customDimensions['spark.ok'])
| summarize
    Calls = count(),
    ['browser p50 ms'] = round(percentile(value, 50)),
    ['browser p95 ms'] = round(percentile(value, 95)),
    ['failed %'] = round(100.0 * countif(Ok == 'false') / count(), 1)
  by Endpoint
| top 25 by ['browser p95 ms'] desc
content.title: API calls as the browser felt them — the gap vs section 2 is the network

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend env = iff(cloud_RoleName has '.', tostring(split(cloud_RoleName, '.')[0]), 'unlabelled')
| where '*' in ({Env}) or env in ({Env})
| where success == false
| summarize Count = count(), Users = dcount(user_Id) by Endpoint = name, Code = resultCode, Service = cloud_RoleName
| top 25 by Count desc
content.title: Failed requests

content.query:
exceptions
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend env = iff(cloud_RoleName has '.', tostring(split(cloud_RoleName, '.')[0]), 'unlabelled')
| where '*' in ({Env}) or env in ({Env})
| summarize Count = count() by Type = type, Method = tostring(method), Service = cloud_RoleName
| top 20 by Count desc
content.title: Server exceptions by type

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'spark.failure'
| extend env = iff(cloud_RoleName has '.', tostring(split(cloud_RoleName, '.')[0]), 'unlabelled')
| where '*' in ({Env}) or env in ({Env})
| summarize Count = count(), Sessions = dcount(session_Id)
  by Where = tostring(customDimensions['spark.label']), Kind = tostring(customDimensions['spark.errorKind'])
| top 20 by Count desc
content.title: Client-side failures — label and error class only, never the message
